donation_guidance: We can accept sealed, in-date packaged food and fresh produce. We cannot accept home-cooked food, opened packets or alcohol.

consent_purpose.dietary: We ask about diets such as vegetarian or vegan so your hamper has food you choose to eat.
consent_purpose.religious: We ask about religious or cultural food needs, such as halal or kosher, so your hamper respects them.
consent_purpose.medical: We ask about medical diets, such as gluten-free, so your hamper is safe for your health.
consent_purpose.allergies: We ask about allergies so we never pack food that could make someone in your household unwell.
consent_purpose.accessibility: We ask about access needs so we can make pickup easier for you.

kiosk.ask_staff: Please ask a staff member for help.
